rules.one_line_why: TaskGraph contract, hard structural rules (4A monolithic pour, 4C rough-inspect bundle, 4E paint two-phase, 4F substantial completion, 4N HVAC stagger, 4R 3-task procurement, 4S PC offset, 4U no-op checkpoints forbidden, 4V customer early items).
TCR scheduling playbook: phase spine, crew sizes + productivity, lead-time table, TN inspection sequence, trade dependency cheat-sheet, paint two-phase, customer-early-item two-bucket pattern.
PEP authoring contract — markdown format, whitespace discipline, per-day mandatory checklist (lead-up sweep, deliveries, trade stack, watch callouts, tomorrow preview).

Addition playbook: TDEC septic (42d lead, offset 30), stick-frame default for small additions, windows IMMEDIATELY after roof framed, MEPs gated on underlayment+windows (NOT dried-in), heat pump relocation before demo, retrofit detection, concealed roof tie-in buffer, amperage check, LVL sub-chain, procurement_long_leads phase, Will's walkthrough.
permit.tdec_septic MUST have pre_construction_offset_working_days: 30 (anchors permit at start of pre-con, not back-pulled from excavation). Skip if home is on city sewer.

Default to stick-framing for additions <800 sqft footprint and roof span <24 ft; skip procurement.trusses. Confidence 0.92. Override only if scope says 'trusses' explicitly OR PM confirms span/footprint over threshold.

notes: _company/rules/_examples/* and _company/beliefs/_examples/* are documentation per CONVENTIONS.md and NOT indexed as live rules. No project-layer or job-layer rules exist for this job.
